module.purpose: Provides the reactive, typed record store used to manage application data, validation, persistence snapshots, change history, queries, side effects, and remote synchronization.
module.summary: This module implements a reactive record store backed by atoms and transactions. It validates and freezes records, tracks additions, updates, and removals, batches history notifications, supports scoped serialization and schema migration, exposes reactive queries and computed caches, and coordinates before/after side effects. Operations can be grouped atomically, attributed to local or remote sources, intercepted, diffed, and replayed while preserving integrity checks and listener filtering.
module.businessContext: Supports collaborative and local application data management across document, session, and presence records. Failure can lose records, corrupt synchronization history, skip validation, or prevent dependent business side effects from running.
